artifact: CIDOC CRM 7.1.3 term registry source manifest

iso_correspondence.relation: CIDOC CRM states that ISO 21127:2023 content corresponds to community version 7.1.3 and that the ISO standard is a distinct product.

namespace_policy.xml_base_resolution: Resolve relative RDF identifiers against the XML Base stated in each downloaded file, retaining the resulting source URI exactly.
namespace_policy.version_iri_handling: Record ontology versionIRI as source metadata; do not append the version path to unversioned CRM term URIs.
namespace_policy.external_terms: Preserve external subject declarations in their source module and mark them as outside the CIDOC CRM namespace.

registry.key: (module, kind, term_id, uri); source-specific encoding declarations and formal-only entries are distinct rows.

field_encoding.domain: compact JSON array of resolved absolute URIs
field_encoding.range: compact JSON array of resolved absolute URIs
field_encoding.superterms: compact JSON array of resolved absolute URIs; subClassOf for class, subPropertyOf for property
field_encoding.inverse: compact JSON array of explicitly declared owl:inverseOf URIs; inverse declarations are separate term rows when declared
field_encoding.deprecated: true only when owl:deprecated has a true-like value; otherwise false
field_encoding.notes: Only short mechanical/module notes; source scope-note prose is intentionally not copied.
field_encoding.empty_relationship: [] means the source module row has no declaration for that relationship; it is not a semantic negative assertion.
field_encoding.resolved_label: Source English label when present; if supplementary row lacks a label but repeats a main-module URI, the main label is copied into this separate field.
field_encoding.resolved_label_source: URI/provenance of source declaration; supplementary duplicate labels identify the main source row used.

registry.source_scope_note: main declarations are RDFS encoding terms, not counts of formal CIDOC CRM concepts; formal_model rows cover formal definitions without a direct main RDFS term URI.

sources.parse_scope: Direct top-level rdfs:Class/owl:Class and rdf:Property/owl:ObjectProperty/owl:DatatypeProperty/owl:AnnotationProperty declarations; rdf:about/rdf:ID and rdf:resource resolved against XML Base; English rdfs:label, direct domain/range, class/property superterms, owl:inverseOf, and owl:deprecated captured. Human rdfs:comment scope notes are not copied.

sources.role: authoritative formal Classes and Properties IDs/short labels for comparison with the RDFS implementation
sources.parsed_scope: In-memory first Table of Classes & Properties: formal IDs and short labels; no scope-note prose copied.

parse_and_validation.scope: This is a declaration registry extracted from the three version 7.1.3 RDFS files, not a parse of the 234-page authoritative definition PDF and not a claim of full semantic coverage. No wiki dump content was read or parsed.
errors_and_limitations: RDFS files are an implementation encoding, not the authoritative definition; consult the version 7.1.3 definition for semantic interpretation.
Supplementary module rows intentionally preserve its additional subPropertyOf declarations as separate rows and do not merge them into main rows.
Supplementary relation-only rows have no local English labels, domains, or ranges; those fields remain empty for that source row.
PC module .1 properties are RDF representations of properties-of-properties, not direct main module properties; their term IDs and module remain separate.

formal_model_comparison.extraction: In-memory parse of the official Table of Classes & Properties, retaining formal IDs and short labels only; no scope-note prose copied.
formal_model_comparison.expected_implementation_difference_evide: The downloaded main RDFS header explicitly states that primitive values become rdfs:Literal, lists E59/E60/E61/E62/E94/E95 as omitted RDFS classes, omits their IsA relationships, and states that inverse declarations cannot be represented when the range is literal. It declares P169i/P170i with rdfs:Literal ranges but no P169/P170 forward term URIs.
